title: No Shortcuts to Infinity: Weil-Petersson Distance in Calabi-Yau Complex Structure Moduli Space
summary: Infinite-distance limits play a central role in the Swampland program, but understanding their behaviour at intersections of boundary divisors is subtle, as it requires control over simultaneous limits of several moduli. To address this, we establish a necessary and sufficient criterion for a boundary stratum of arbitrary codimension in the complex-structure moduli space of Calabi-Yau manifolds to lie at infinite Weil-Petersson distance.
